mapper.select: SELECT checkpoint_seq AS checkpointSeq, thread_id AS threadId, base_thread_id AS baseThreadId, execute_round AS executeRound, node_id AS nodeId, next_node_id AS nextNodeId, state_data_json AS stateDataJson, saved_at AS savedAt FROM GRAPH_CHECKPOINT WHERE base_thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY checkpoint_seq ASC

SELECT checkpoint_seq AS checkpointSeq, checkpoint_id AS checkpointId, thread_id AS threadId, node_id AS nodeId, next_node_id AS nextNodeId, state_data AS stateData, state_data_json AS stateDataJson, saved_at AS savedAt FROM GRAPH_CHECKPOINT WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY checkpoint_seq DESC LIMIT 1
